subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw accept the generic account-scoped channel reload contract and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99312 as the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the bug on current main, but choosing a generic account-scoped reload contract affects gateway lifecycle compatibility across bundled and external channel plugins.

options.title: Review PR 99312 as canonical
options.body: Use the newer mergeable, proof-positive PR as the main landing path for account-scoped reloads if gateway owners accept its generic contract.

options.title: Revive PR 43938
options.body: Ask the original PR author to resolve conflicts and add real behavior proof if maintainers prefer that narrower branch.

options.title: Reject account-scoped reloads
options.body: Keep whole-channel restarts as the product contract and close the implementation PRs with a documented alternative for reload disruption.

recommendation.title: Review PR 99312 as canonical
recommendation.body: Use the newer mergeable, proof-positive PR as the main landing path for account-scoped reloads if gateway owners accept its generic contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current routing candidate from blame and recent gateway/channel file history.
